package.name: Finco1 Generic Reference Model Inventory Template

status_meaning.candidate: Identified as a candidate; not yet evaluated against the six-component test
status_meaning.incomplete: One or more required components in the six-component test are missing
status_meaning.transcribed: Inputs and outputs have been transcribed to the Finco1 input format and a structured comparison sheet
status_meaning.parity-pass: First parity run on transcribed inputs matches the source within tolerance
status_meaning.parity-fail: First parity run on transcribed inputs does not match the source within tolerance
status_meaning.accepted: Parity results have been internally reviewed and the reference is accepted for generic validation work

global_notes: This inventory is empty at package creation. It will be populated per the acquisition workflow as candidates are identified and evaluated.
Each entry must record source, licence, inputs, outputs, tolerances, and replay instructions per the six-component test in generic_reference_acquisition_plan.md §2.

A reference is rejected if any required component is missing, if the licence is incompatible with internal use, or if the reference is essentially a copy of TUHO, Oborovo, or any other Finco1-produced model.
Generic solar and generic wind remain exploratory and unvalidated for any external claim. See the no-go boundaries document for the full list.
